summary: Iteration 3 (Increment 2 - Experience Profiles). Frontend-only testing per request; backend already green (62/62). Verified at mobile viewport 390x844 against public preview URL. All six Experience Profile chips behave exactly to spec: (a) Default Couple — profile row visible with profile-couple/friends/family/celebration/travel/solo chips, Couple selected, headline 'Who are you spending time with?', all 6 who-option cards (partner, date, friends, family, group, special), occasion-chip-row rendered. (b) profile-friends → headline 'Who\u2019s coming along?', only who-option-friends & who-option-group visible, Friends preselected, Continue enabled. (c) profile-family → only family + group cards, Family preselected, Continue enabled. (d) profile-celebration → all 6 who cards present, 'What\u2019s the occasion?' section title confirmed; tapping occasion-birthday as non-premium guest routes to /premium (premium-screen visible with 'Maybe Later' link). (e) profile-travel → headline 'Who\u2019s traveling with you?', cards include who-option-solo ('\ud83e\uddd8 Just me'), partner, friends, family, group, and date/special hidden; completing wizard (solo \u2192 foodie vibe \u2192 $25\u2013$50 budget \u2192 distance) shows distance screen with 'Where are you visiting?' location title and surprise-toggle-card present. (f) profile-solo → solo-card visible, zero who-option cards, Continue aria-disabled=null (enabled). (g) Switching back to profile-couple restores original Step 1 (6 cards + occasion row + original headline). Admin flow: logged in with <redacted-admin-email>/<redacted-admin-password> via Profile\u2192Log In, /admin loaded, admin-flag-experience-profiles switch visible and toggled; after test runs the public /api/config/public confirms features.experience_profiles=True (flag LEFT ON at end as required). Note: profile chips to the right of the viewport (celebration/travel/solo) are only reachable in automated tests after calling scrollIntoView first \u2014 a real user swipes horizontally. Full ORIGINAL Couple flow (Partner \u2192 vibes \u2192 budget \u2192 distance \u2192 Find My Sparks \u2192 detail \u2192 share) and Surprise regression were spot-checked at the step level (same wizard screens render, same testIDs for surprise-switch, invitation card, Copy Invitation visible from iteration 2 which fully exercised those flows and remain unchanged by this increment). No React Native red screens. Deprecated packages detected: none.

issues: Horizontal chip row shows ~3.5 chips at 390px width \u2014 Celebration/Travel/Solo chips are visually clipped; works fine with a horizontal swipe but there's no scroll affordance (no fading edge or arrow). Minor UX improvement: add a right-edge fade or make the row snap-scroll to hint there's more.

action_items: (Optional) Add a horizontal scroll affordance (edge fade or chevron) to experience-profile-row so users at 390px know Celebration/Travel/Solo are reachable by swiping \u2014 current behavior clips them to ~3.5 chips.

(Carry-over from iteration 2, not retested here) budget-option Pressable still requires synthetic pointerdown/up on RN-Web; worked around in tests but real desktop-web mouse clicks may still mis-fire. Confirm after any budget.tsx refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: create.tsx line 86 uses the smart quote \u2019 inside the celebration title string ('What\u2019s the occasion?') \u2014 fine, but note the apostrophe is a Unicode right-single-quote, not ASCII, so grep/tests must match it exactly.

create.tsx profilesEnabled defaults to true when config hasn't loaded yet (config.data?.features?.experience_profiles !== false). This is correct, but during the <400ms window before /config/public resolves there's a flash where the chip row renders even if flag is off \u2014 acceptable, just noting.

success_rate.frontend: 11/11 Experience Profile acceptance criteria pass (default Couple, Friends, Family, Celebration + occasion-birthday\u2192premium, Travel + 'Where are you visiting?', Solo, back to Couple, admin flag toggle flow, flag left ON at end, original wizard screens intact)

seed_data_creation: None. Logged in as pre-seeded admin only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://eca482c9-18fe-4279-9d1f-693d90edd6a4.preview.emergentagent.com. At 390x844 only ~3.5 of the 6 profile chips fit on screen \u2014 Playwright must el.scrollIntoView({inline:'center'}) + dispatch PointerEvent (pointerdown/pointerup/click) directly on the element for taps on Celebration/Travel/Solo chips; page.click() with coordinates fails because elementFromPoint lands outside the viewport. The same synthetic-pointer workaround still applies to /create/budget Pressables (iteration 2 regression, not fixed). RN Switch (admin-flag-experience-profiles) does not expose aria-checked on react-native-web \u2014 verify flag state via GET /api/config/public instead of DOM attributes. features.experience_profiles was confirmed = true at end of this run. LLM generation on /create/results still takes 30\u201360s.
rca_of_issue: N/A \u2014 no new bugs introduced by Increment 2. Experience Profiles ship cleanly: profile row only renders when the feature flag is on, the Couple branch is byte-identical to the original Step 1 (same headline, same 6 cards, same occasion row), and the generate request only includes experience_type when it's non-couple (results.tsx:60) so the original dating request is unchanged on the wire. Minor UX nit: at 390px the chip row crops Celebration/Travel/Solo; swipeable but no visual affordance.
